examples.english: The orchard produced an abundant harvest of apples this autumn.
examples.persian: باغ میوه در این پاییز محصول فراوانی از سیب تولید کرد.

miniContext: The orchard produced an abundant harvest of apples this autumn.

examples.english: The weather forecast turned out to be remarkably accurate.
examples.persian: پیش‌بینی آب‌وهوا به طرز قابل توجهی دقیق از آب درآمد.

miniContext: The weather forecast turned out to be remarkably accurate.

examples.english: Two hours of sleep is not adequate for a growing teenager.
examples.persian: دو ساعت خواب برای یک نوجوان در حال رشد کافی نیست.

miniContext: Two hours of sleep is not adequate for a growing teenager.

examples.english: Her patience with the difficult customer was truly admirable.
examples.persian: شکیبایی او در برابر آن مشتری سختگیر واقعاً قابل تحسین بود.

miniContext: Her patience with the difficult customer was truly admirable.

examples.english: It became apparent that the old bridge needed urgent repairs.
examples.persian: آشکار شد که پل قدیمی به تعمیرات فوری نیاز دارد.

miniContext: It became apparent that the old bridge needed urgent repairs.

examples.english: Jeans are not appropriate attire for a formal wedding.
examples.persian: شلوار جین پوشش مناسبی برای یک عروسی رسمی نیست.

miniContext: Jeans are not appropriate attire for a formal wedding.

examples.english: She learned to be more assertive when negotiating her salary.
examples.persian: او یاد گرفت هنگام مذاکره بر سر حقوقش قاطع‌تر و بااعتمادبه‌نفس‌تر باشد.

miniContext: She learned to be more assertive when negotiating her salary.

examples.english: The nurse remained attentive to every patient throughout her shift.
examples.persian: پرستار در طول نوبت کاری‌اش با دقت و توجه به همه بیماران رسیدگی کرد.

miniContext: The nurse remained attentive to every patient throughout her shift.

examples.english: The small restaurant serves authentic Persian dishes passed down through generations.
examples.persian: آن رستوران کوچک غذاهای اصیل و واقعی ایرانی را که نسل به نسل منتقل شده سرو می‌کند.

miniContext: The small restaurant serves authentic Persian dishes passed down through generations.

examples.english: Regular exercise is beneficial for both the body and the mind.
examples.persian: ورزش منظم برای بدن و ذهن سودمند است.

miniContext: Regular exercise is beneficial for both the body and the mind.

examples.english: The young engineer proved capable of solving problems no one else could.
examples.persian: آن مهندس جوان توانمند بود که مشکلاتی را حل کند که هیچ‌کس دیگری نتوانسته بود.

miniContext: The young engineer proved capable of solving problems no one else could.

examples.english: Drivers should be cautious on icy roads during winter.
examples.persian: رانندگان باید در زمستان در جاده‌های یخ‌زده محتاط باشند.

miniContext: Drivers should be cautious on icy roads during winter.

examples.english: The new accountant handled the audit in a competent manner.
examples.persian: حسابدار جدید بازرسی را به شیوه‌ای شایسته و کارآمد انجام داد.

miniContext: The new accountant handled the audit in a competent manner.

examples.english: He was considerate enough to lower his voice while the baby was sleeping.
examples.persian: او آنقدر ملاحظه‌کار بود که صدایش را پایین بیاورد تا نوزاد بخواب باشد.

miniContext: He was considerate enough to lower his voice while the baby was sleeping.

examples.english: Her grades have remained consistent throughout the semester.
examples.persian: نمرات او در طول ترم با ثبات و سازگار باقی مانده است.

miniContext: Her grades have remained consistent throughout the semester.

examples.english: The teacher offered constructive feedback instead of simply criticizing the essay.
examples.persian: معلم به‌جای اینکه فقط انشا را نقد کند، بازخورد سازنده‌ای ارائه داد.

miniContext: The teacher offered constructive feedback instead of simply criticizing the essay.

examples.english: His argument for renewable energy was convincing enough to change her mind.
examples.persian: استدلال او درباره انرژی‌های تجدیدپذیر آنقدر قانع‌کننده بود که نظر او را تغییر داد.

miniContext: His argument for renewable energy was convincing enough to change her mind.

examples.english: The hotel staff were courteous to every guest who checked in.
examples.persian: کارکنان هتل با هر مهمانی که وارد می‌شد مودبانه برخورد می‌کردند.

miniContext: The hotel staff were courteous to every guest who checked in.

examples.english: Journalists must rely on credible sources before publishing a story.
examples.persian: خبرنگاران باید پیش از انتشار یک خبر به منابع قابل اعتماد تکیه کنند.

miniContext: Journalists must rely on credible sources before publishing a story.

examples.english: The coach made a decisive substitution that changed the outcome of the match.
examples.persian: مربی یک تغییر قاطع انجام داد که نتیجه بازی را تغییر داد.

miniContext: The coach made a decisive substitution that changed the outcome of the match.

examples.english: She took a deliberate pause before answering the difficult question.
examples.persian: او پیش از پاسخ به آن سوال دشوار، مکثی سنجیده و عمدی کرد.

miniContext: She took a deliberate pause before answering the difficult question.

examples.english: My older brother has always been a dependable source of advice.
examples.persian: برادر بزرگ‌تر من همیشه منبعی قابل اتکا برای مشاوره بوده است.

miniContext: My older brother has always been a dependable source of advice.

examples.english: A quiet neighborhood is highly desirable for families with young children.
examples.persian: یک محله آرام برای خانواده‌هایی با فرزندان خرد بسیار مطلوب است.

miniContext: A quiet neighborhood is highly desirable for families with young children.

examples.english: The diligent student reviewed her notes every night before the exam.
examples.persian: آن دانش‌آموز کوشا هر شب پیش از امتحان یادداشت‌هایش را مرور می‌کرد.

miniContext: The diligent student reviewed her notes every night before the exam.

examples.english: The two wines had a distinct flavor despite being made from the same grape.
examples.persian: آن دو شراب با وجود اینکه از همان انگور تهیه شده بودند، طعمی متمایز داشتند.

miniContext: The two wines had a distinct flavor despite being made from the same grape.

examples.english: A short daily walk can be an effective way to reduce stress.
examples.persian: یک پیاده‌روی کوتاه روزانه می‌تواند راهی موثر برای کاهش استرس باشد.

miniContext: A short daily walk can be an effective way to reduce stress.

examples.english: The new assembly line is far more efficient than the old one.
examples.persian: خط تولید جدید بسیار کارآمدتر از خط قدیمی است.

miniContext: The new assembly line is far more efficient than the old one.

examples.english: Only employees with two years of service are eligible for the bonus.
examples.persian: فقط کارمندانی که دو سال خدمت کرده‌اند واجد شرایط دریافت پاداش هستند.

miniContext: Only employees with two years of service are eligible for the bonus.

examples.english: The children were enthusiastic about building a sandcastle on the beach.
examples.persian: بچه‌ها برای ساختن یک قلعه شنی در ساحل بسیار مشتاق بودند.

miniContext: The children were enthusiastic about building a sandcastle on the beach.

examples.english: Clean water is essential for survival in any climate.
examples.persian: آب تمیز برای زنده ماندن در هر آب‌وهوایی ضروری است.

miniContext: Clean water is essential for survival in any climate.
